The structure of Ca8Zn4Se4S4 (reduced formula Ca2ZnSeS) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fdd2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between four-vertex Ca coordination polyhedra.
